intro: We support organisations, local authorities and educational institutions that want to question their relationship with digital technology, uncertainty and planetary boundaries. Every session is built with you, around your own challenges.

actions.texte: Designing and running a citizens' convention at your scale: random selection, expert hearings, deliberation and reporting back.
Imagining tools, services or low-tech solutions together with the people who will use them.
Supporting a team or organisation as it reflects on its direction, its impact and its digital dependencies.
